localityGuide.title: Pune Residential Locality Guide
localityGuide.subtitle: Practical, transparent neighborhood data to help you evaluate commute times, pricing trends, and social infrastructure across Pune.

localities.name: Baner
localities.tagline: West Pune IT Hub & Lifestyle Epicenter
localities.commuteHighlights: 10 mins to Hinjewadi Phase 1 • 25 mins to Pune Station
localities.description: Baner is West Pune's most vibrant residential corridor. Known for Balewadi High Street's gourmet cafes, reputable schools, and seamless expressway access for weekend trips to Mumbai.

localities.name: Kharadi
localities.tagline: East IT SEZ Corridor & Riverfront Growth
localities.commuteHighlights: 5 mins to EON IT Park & WTC • 15 mins to Pune Airport
localities.description: East Pune's powerhouse employment zone with massive tech campuses. Kharadi features wide arterial roads, riverside developments, and high rental yields from multinational IT workforce.

localities.name: Viman Nagar
localities.commuteHighlights: 5 mins to Pune Airport • 10 mins to Koregaon Park
localities.description: A prestigious, mature residential neighborhood with leafy avenues, premier retail destinations, and seamless access to Koregaon Park and Kalyani Nagar.

localities.name: Hadapsar & Magarpatta
localities.commuteHighlights: Inside Magarpatta Cybercity • 15 mins to SP Infocity
localities.description: Pune's pioneer in walk-to-work townships. Magarpatta City and Amanora offer gated self-sustained living with top schools, shopping malls, and corporate campuses within walking distance.

localities.name: Wakad
localities.commuteHighlights: 7 mins to Hinjewadi Tech Gate • 2 mins to Mumbai Highway
localities.description: The top choice for Hinjewadi IT professionals seeking modern high-rises. Boasts the newly opened Phoenix Mall of the Millennium, top CBSE schools, and rapid connectivity.

testimonials.title: Homebuyer Stories & Verified Reviews
testimonials.subtitle: Read genuine experiences from families who found their dream home in Pune through Shubh Properties.

items.propertyPurchased: 3 BHK at Riverfront Grandeur, Kharadi (₹1.15 Crore)
items.quote: Finding a 3 BHK near EON Free Zone without paying 2% unnecessary brokerage seemed impossible until we contacted Sanjay Kulkarni. He arranged 4 site visits in a single Saturday, verified the developer's RERA escrow account, and helped us get our SBI home loan approved within 6 working days.

items.propertyPurchased: 4 BHK Penthouse at Aeropolis, Viman Nagar (₹2.35 Crore)
items.quote: As practicing doctors, we had zero time to verify title deeds or follow up with sub-registrar offices. Amit Shinde handled the entire legal chain of documents, clarified the carpet area compliance under RERA, and accompanied us during final key handover. Exemplary professionalism.

items.propertyPurchased: 2 BHK at Greenfield Heights, Wakad (₹72 Lakh)
items.quote: Being first-time buyers, we were anxious about construction delays and hidden costs. Deepa Joshi patiently explained the stamp duty calculations, checked the PCMC completion certificate, and helped us secure a covered car park spot. We moved in with complete peace of mind!

We purchased this apartment for rental income and our daughter's college commute. Shubh Properties assisted with seamless registration at Haveli Sub-Registrar office and even helped us connect with a corporate tenant within 3 weeks of possession.
